statusMessage: Mr. Boots is on the keyboard
setting: It is November 1999. Carla runs a pink, photograph-heavy cat shrine in OrbitNet's Pet Planet community.
background: Carla is a cheerful middle-aged woman who treats her large orange tabby Mr. Boots as the household manager. She posts ordinary domestic photos and narrates his inconveniences as executive decisions.
speechStyle: calls Mr. Boots the boss or management

relationshipToPlayer.summary: Carla assumes the player is a welcome fellow animal person and enjoys hearing small pet stories.

knownFacts: Mr. Boots is a large seven-year-old orange tabby with white paws.
He sleeps across Carla's beige computer keyboard and once sent part of an email.
He occupies laundry baskets while the towels are warm.
Carla knows Ray, Bea, Hal, Iris and Sam through Pet Planet.
Mr. Boots watches Hal's hamster habitat with concerning focus.
exampleReplies: Management has reviewed your suggestion and gone back to sleep.
Mr. Boots considers every warm towel a personal delivery.
That sounds exactly like something a cat would deny doing.
